scope: Candidate constructs and observable proxies for campaigns after metric-conditioned optimization v1.1; this file is not a LossSpec and cannot alter the active campaign.

normative_stance.loss_metric_separation: A proxy exposed to search becomes an optimization input and must receive a distinct untouched evaluation split; diagnostics named held-out remain search-invisible.

source_snapshot.survey_topic_map: research/TOPIC-MAP.md sections Science of Science, research funding, and research evaluation

constructs.label: Epistemic progress
constructs.definition: Change in warranted uncertainty about typed claims, including informative negative results, rather than growth in publications or acceptance decisions.
constructs.normative_question: Which questions and audiences should count, and is uncertainty reduction valuable when it does not improve a mission outcome?

observable_proxies.description: Prior-to-posterior uncertainty reduction on preregistered typed claims, credited only after an independent verification event and retaining negative results in the denominator.
observable_proxies.observable: sum over claims of audience-weighted information gain multiplied by verification-independence weight, reported with attempted and unverifiable claim counts

aggregation.within_run: time-discounted sum plus annual trajectory; do not discard negative or unresolved claims
aggregation.across_seeds: median and percentile interval with per-seed values; no imputation for missing verification
aggregation.reporting: jointly report claim count, verification coverage, baseline entropy, and information-gain distribution

goodhart_risks: selecting easy low-entropy claims with cheap verification
manipulating priors or audience choice to manufacture surprise
splitting claims to multiply credited information gain

required_simulator_fields.purpose: define the epistemic unit and revisions

required_simulator_fields.field: prior_probability and posterior_probability by declared audience

required_simulator_fields.purpose: separate independent constraint from evaluator agreement

held_out_diagnostic_relation.rationale: Current activity diagnostics cannot validate epistemic progress; a future implementation must first establish claim and verification semantics.

implementation.next_step: Add a versioned claim/evidence/verification event model and validate it on synthetic ground-truth worlds before defining a LossSpec.

constructs.label: Useful novelty and exploration
constructs.definition: New combinations, representations, questions, or discriminating tests that expand reachable inquiry while remaining answerable to evidence.
constructs.normative_question: How much resource should be reserved for speculative novelty versus consolidation, and who bears its opportunity cost?

observable_proxies.description: Portfolio share combining a conventional evidence base with an atypical relation or genuinely new discriminating test, with later validation tracked separately.
observable_proxies.observable: joint distribution of conventionality, atypicality, discriminating-test novelty, and later validation; never semantic distance alone

aggregation.within_run: portfolio distribution by year with tail mass and latency-to-validation
aggregation.across_seeds: paired seed contrasts and percentile interval for each component
aggregation.reporting: four-component vector and scatterplot; no single novelty total

goodhart_risks: incoherent recombination rewarded as novelty
cosmetic reframing or ontology splitting
abandoning replication and cumulative development
optimizing audience priors to create surprise

required_simulator_fields.purpose: separate conventional base from atypical combination
distinguish new tests from textual novelty

held_out_diagnostic_relation.rationale: If a future search uses this portfolio signal, later validation and current topic-entropy diagnostics must remain on distinct seeds or scenarios.

implementation.next_step: Prototype the distribution without optimizer exposure, then test construct validity against hand-coded coherent and incoherent novelty fixtures.

constructs.label: Epistemic robustness and correction
constructs.definition: Persistence of appropriately scoped claims across independent data, methods, contexts, and challenges, together with timely propagation of corrections.
constructs.normative_question: Which claims merit scarce replication capacity, and how much heterogeneity should count as failure rather than scope information?

observable_proxies.description: Vector of replication attempt coverage, effect/claim agreement under independent lineages, correction latency, and stale downstream reliance.
observable_proxies.observable: replication attempts and outcomes linked to claim versions, plus time from invalidation to correction and dependent-decision update

aggregation.across_seeds: per-component medians and intervals, preserving attempted/unattempted denominators
aggregation.reporting: replication coverage, heterogeneity, correction latency, and stale reliance remain separate

goodhart_risks: testing only easy claims
narrowing claim scope after failure without recording revisions
discouraging risky research to maximize survival
using correlated model lineages as independent replications

required_simulator_fields.purpose: bind replication to the tested claim

required_simulator_fields.field: method, data, model, and evaluator lineage
required_simulator_fields.purpose: measure independence rather than actor count

held_out_diagnostic_relation.rationale: Review completion and decisions are process diagnostics, not evidence that claims replicate or corrections propagate.

implementation.next_step: Implement claim-version and replication/correction events, then test recovery on seeded false-claim and heterogeneous-effect worlds.

constructs.label: Epistemic and institutional diversity
constructs.definition: Variety, balance, and disparity across topics, methods, evidence, lineages, institutions, and surviving branches, including their ability to interact coherently.
constructs.normative_question: Which distinctions deserve preservation, and when does concentration reflect useful specialization rather than premature closure?

observable_proxies.description: Topic or lineage variety and balance weighted by pairwise disparity, accompanied by branch survival, reopening, and integration coherence.
observable_proxies.observable: Rao-Stirling diversity over a frozen ontology/distance matrix plus branch survival and cross-branch evidence integration

aggregation.within_run: area under annual diversity trajectory plus end-state branch survival and reopening rates
aggregation.across_seeds: component-wise mean, population SD, and rank stability
aggregation.reporting: variety, balance, disparity, survival, and coherence are shown independently

goodhart_risks: splitting near-identical topics to increase variety
maintaining unproductive branches indefinitely
maximizing disparity while destroying coherence
confusing shared foundation-model outputs with independent lineages

required_simulator_fields.field: frozen topic or lineage distance matrix
branch parent, suspended, extinct, and reopened events

held_out_diagnostic_relation.rationale: The current topic-entropy probe is an adversarial proxy arm; this richer construct would require a new campaign and independent branch/coherence diagnostics.

implementation.next_step: Add a versioned ontology and distance matrix, then compare entropy and Rao-Stirling rankings before any optimization use.

constructs.label: Participation and research-capacity continuity
constructs.definition: The ability of heterogeneous researchers to enter, remain, exercise meaningful research routes, exit voluntarily, and regain capability after shocks.
constructs.normative_question: Whose participation is valuable, what constitutes meaningful agency rather than forced retention, and which burdens are acceptable?

observable_proxies.description: Cohort survival and attrition combined with access to proposal, review, resource, collaboration, challenge, and voluntary-exit routes.
observable_proxies.observable: initial-cohort survival curve and route-specific opportunity/use rates by preregistered resource and career strata

aggregation.within_run: survival curve, route coverage, burden, and exit-reason distribution
aggregation.across_seeds: paired strata contrasts with uncertainty; retain zero-opportunity denominators
aggregation.reporting: aggregate and preregistered slices, with route access separate from route use

goodhart_risks: preventing voluntary exit to improve retention
keeping inactive or under-resourced agents nominally active
increasing low-value submissions to simulate participation
averaging away blocked routes for low-resource cohorts

required_simulator_fields.purpose: measure cohort continuity without outcome-conditioned slicing

required_simulator_fields.field: submission, review, funding, and collaboration events

held_out_diagnostic_relation.rationale: Active-researcher fraction can be a future loss component only when untouched attrition, route, and burden diagnostics use separate seeds.

implementation.next_step: Build a report-only route ledger and validate access/use/exit semantics before proposing any new scalar LossSpec.

constructs.label: Resource and verification efficiency
constructs.definition: Marginal warranted knowledge, reusable capability, or commitment-specific outcome produced per scarce resource and time, with burden and latency retained.
constructs.normative_question: Which outputs count in the numerator, what capabilities must not be treated as overhead, and whose labor or opportunity cost is counted?

observable_proxies.description: Marginal verified epistemic or mission return over funding, compute, researcher time, review labor, and latency, retaining reusable infrastructure as a separate output.
observable_proxies.observable: incremental verified return by resource band and design, with total resource ledger, queue time, and capability creation

aggregation.within_run: annual marginal-return curve and cumulative cost/outcome frontier
aggregation.across_seeds: paired design contrasts and bootstrap interval; do not ratio aggregate totals without support
aggregation.reporting: numerator, each denominator, latency, and capability outputs shown separately

goodhart_risks: choosing easy cheap work and suppressing hard high-option-value research
eliminating review or replication to reduce measured burden
shifting costs to unlogged actors or future periods
counting unverified quantity as return

required_simulator_fields.field: funding allocation, inflow, ending balance, application pipeline
compute, application, administration, and maintenance labor

held_out_diagnostic_relation.rationale: The current ledger and activity counts diagnose resources and process but do not provide a validated return numerator.

implementation.next_step: Complete cost accounting and pair it with a validated epistemic or mission outcome; until then keep efficiency report-only.

constructs.label: Mission-specific public value
constructs.definition: Benefits, burdens, risks, option costs, and capabilities produced for explicitly identified publics under a versioned mission and authority relation.
constructs.normative_question: Who defines the mission, who has standing, whose harms cannot be averaged away, and when may public authority revise or stop it?

observable_proxies.description: Commitment-specific target attainment reported with uncertainty, benefit and burden distributions, externalities, affected-party standing, and alternative portfolio cost.
observable_proxies.observable: mission outcome by beneficiary/loss-bearer group plus risk, time, excluded alternatives, appeal, independent verification, and public counter-capacity

aggregation.within_run: mission milestone trajectory and group-specific benefit/burden distributions
aggregation.across_seeds: scenario-conditional uncertainty and worst-supported group outcomes; no national aggregate utility
aggregation.reporting: vector of attainment, distribution, independence, contestability, alternatives, and recovery

goodhart_risks: equating official targets with public value
hiding minority, non-user, future-generation, or environmental losses in aggregates
self-certification when mission owner also evaluates success
short KPI windows extinguishing long-latency options

required_simulator_fields.purpose: bound the commitment and revision authority

held_out_diagnostic_relation.rationale: Funding and participation can reveal burdens but cannot stand in for public outcomes or legitimate mission choice.

implementation.next_step: Implement one explicitly bounded synthetic mission scenario with separate outcome, authority, and affected-party objects; do not generalize it to scientific value.

candidate_loss_families.proposal: Compare search under information gain, independent verification, and correction-aware variants after claim semantics exist; retain each component and cross-evaluate on untouched worlds.
prerequisites: new optimization and held-out seed allocations

candidate_loss_families.proposal: Run separate arms for atypical-test exploration, disparity-aware diversity, and branch-option preservation rather than one weighted novelty score.
Compare end-state retention, route access, and shock-recovery objectives as separate arms to reveal which institutional designs each induces.
Explore Pareto frontiers between verified return, cost categories, latency, and capability preservation; do not optimize paper or review counts per cost.
For one declared synthetic mission, compare attainment-focused, distribution-aware, and counter-capacity-preserving arms while reporting all dimensions and authority assumptions.

composition_strategies.description: Hold simulator, design space, optimizer, budget, and seeds fixed while changing one declared LossSpec family per arm.
composition_strategies.reporting_requirement: Cross-evaluate frozen winners on common untouched metrics and report rank reversals and induced system differences.

composition_strategies.description: Retain non-dominated systems over multiple declared dimensions without choosing permanent scalar weights.
composition_strategies.reporting_requirement: Publish the frontier, uncertainty, dominated systems, and stakeholder- or mission-specific views.

composition_strategies.description: Use a preregistered temporary scalarization only as an optimizer interface for one bounded commitment.
composition_strategies.reporting_requirement: Preserve every component, weights, sensitivity analysis, authority, expiry, and alternative scalarizations.

composition_strategies.description: Optimize one declared objective while bounding another only when the bound is explicitly part of that campaign's scientific question.
composition_strategies.reporting_requirement: Report feasibility, binding frequency, threshold sensitivity, and results without the bound.

citations.title: Science of science
citations.claim_supported: Science-of-science describes mechanisms of scientific activity and policy-relevant regularities but does not itself supply a universal normative objective.

citations.title: Atypical combinations and scientific impact
citations.claim_supported: High-impact work often combines a conventional knowledge base with some atypical combinations; novelty is not a monotone distance target.

citations.title: Reproducibility and Replicability in Science
citations.authors: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
citations.claim_supported: Computational reproducibility and empirical replicability are distinct constructs and require explicit attempt and context information.

citations.title: A general framework for analysing diversity in science, technology and society
citations.claim_supported: Diversity has separable variety, balance, and disparity components, so entropy alone is incomplete.

citations.title: Big Science vs. Little Science: How Scientific Impact Scales with Funding
citations.claim_supported: Observed funding-impact relations may have diminishing returns, motivating marginal-return analysis without implying universal small-grant optimality.

citations.title: 単一目的関数なしに『望ましい科学制度』を設計する方法
citations.claim_supported: Scientific values conflict; commitments, constraints, revision authority, and proxy risks must remain explicit rather than becoming one permanent score.

citations.title: 問いの前に何が起きるか――科学的可能性空間の制度的構成とAI時代
citations.claim_supported: Idea count and semantic spread do not measure independent lineage, world access, discriminating tests, branch survival, or reopening capacity.

citations.title: Science of Science allocation survey
citations.claim_supported: Allocation interacts with cumulative advantage, signal latency, novelty bias, and data-rich concentration; observed outputs and causal returns must be separated.

citations.title: Participation is a typed routing circuit, not one state
citations.claim_supported: Participation is object-, route-, and phase-specific; non-observation and retention are not sufficient participation measures.

locator.section_or_lines: construct definition, route-state distinctions, and falsifiers

citations.title: 科学的価値を誰が変えられるのか
citations.claim_supported: Epistemic, agenda, deployment, and constitutional judgments have different authorities; public funds strengthen standing and appeal requirements.

citations.title: ScienceUtopia の制度最適化における目的関数候補
citations.claim_supported: Maps science-of-science constructs to simulator observables and documents proxy, diversity, robustness, efficiency, and public-value limitations.

citations.title: ai-scientist-survey からの目的関数・制度設計メモ
citations.claim_supported: Translates pinned ai-scientist-survey syntheses into event-schema, public-mission, participation, and objective-governance requirements.
